title: Fix 3 shape calculation bugs in Rust: wrong PI, wrong perimeter, wrong hypotenuse
description: A Rust shape calculator library has three deliberate math bugs: using 3.14 instead of PI, computing perimeter as 2w+h instead of 2(w+h), and computing hypotenuse as sqrt(a+b) instead of sqrt(a²+b²). All three tests fail. Fix the bugs.

followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
